18 seasons of No. 7
MS Dhoni retires from the IPL

Whistlepodu.
Thala Bids Adieu.

After 18 seasons, five IPL titles and no farewell match, MS Dhoni has finally hung up his IPL boots. But the Thala era isn’t over just yet. Dhoni will continue to mentor Chennai Super Kings.

17 November 2026
One shirt, one numberFor 18 IPL seasons, there was one constant in yellow: No. 7.
RewindScroll back through every season he played. Yellow for Chennai, purple for the two years in Pune.
2008Chennai paid US$1.5 million for him at the first IPL auction, the highest price of that auction. He was 26.
2026He missed the entire 2026 season with injuries, the first IPL season ever played without him. Then, on 17 November, he stopped.

Whistlepodu. Thala bids adieu.

Saturday, 14 November

The retirement that arrived as one line on a video call

CSK were finalising which players to let go before the IPL 2027 retention deadline. Managing director Kasi Viswanathan was reading out the release list. Dhoni, on the call, had a suggestion.

    Owner Rupa Gurunath says he had hinted months earlier that he was unsure he could play another season.

    Right after the line, the call dropped. When she rang back, she joked that even the internet could not handle the news.

    CSK announced it on Tuesday, 17 November, the deadline day for IPL 2027 retentions.

    The late hitter, aged 42
    2008–2025278 matches and 5,439 runs. Stars mark the five seasons Chennai won the title.
    The peaksHis best run tallies came in 2013 (461) and 2018 (455). 2018 was Chennai's comeback season after a two-year suspension, and they won the title.
    The Pune detourWhile CSK were suspended in 2016 and 2017, he played two seasons for Rising Pune Supergiant, his only IPL team other than Chennai.
    The late twistAs the runs fell, the hitting got faster. In 2024, aged 42, he struck at 220.55, his best ever, batting mostly in the last two or three overs.
    The captain

    Ten finals with Chennai. Five trophies.

    No one has led more IPL matches. He captained in 235 of them, including one season at Pune, before handing the CSK armband to Ruturaj Gaikwad in March 2024.

    Ahmedabad, 2023: title No. 5. He stood back and let the squad lift it.

    Where the story happened

    A Ranchi boy who made Chennai home

    He grew up nearly 1,600 km from Chepauk. Chennai adopted him anyway. Tap a place on the list.

    Map not to scale. India’s boundaries as officially depicted. Dubai (2021 final) is shown by an arrow.

    One club, one career

    Among the great one-club careers in world sport

    Football and basketball have their one-club legends. Their careers ran longer, but their clubs were decades older. Dhoni played in every season Chennai played until 2026.

    Seasons spent with a single club. Dhoni's count is his 16 seasons with CSK; he also played two for Rising Pune Supergiant while CSK were suspended.

    The Dhoni effect

    When he walked out, the whole country tuned in

    In 2023, the year of his fifth title, the live-streaming record broke three times in seven weeks. Each time, Chennai and Dhoni were on screen.

    2.2 cr12 April · vs Rajasthan Royals, as Dhoni nearly pulled off a last-over chase
    2.4 cr17 April · vs Royal Challengers Bangalore in Bengaluru
    3.2 cr29 May · the final vs Gujarat Titans, a world record for live streaming
    $235mCSK's brand value in 2025, third in the IPL according to Houlihan Lokey. They had been No. 1 the year before.
    $18.5bnvalue of the whole IPL business in 2025, up 12.9% in a year

    Peak concurrent viewers on JioCinema in 2023. One crore is 10 million.

    The long goodbye

    How Chennai kept paying for him, and how the price changed

    Each retention told the story of a player getting older and a franchise refusing to let go.

    The price tag

    What Chennai paid to keep him, in ₹ crore

    The last three years

    From captain to cameo to absent

    2024

    Hands the captaincy to Ruturaj Gaikwad on the eve of the season.

    2025

    Leads again after Gaikwad's injury. CSK finish last for the first time.

    2026

    Injuries rule him out of the whole season. CSK miss the playoffs for a third straight year.

    Nov 2026

    Retires as a player. The Chepauk farewell he reportedly wanted never happened.

    His last game in yellow was in May 2025. Nobody knew it was the last.

    Around the league

    Playing on at 43

    Only two men have played in the IPL at an older age than he was in his last match.

    The 2008 auction price was US$1.5 million, about ₹6 crore at the time. In 2025 he was retained as an “uncapped” player, a rule for those retired from international cricket for five years.

    What happens now

    From No. 7 to the dugout

    CSK created a team mentor role for him from IPL 2027. He will work with the captain, the players and the coaching staff.

    The new job: teaching what he used to do
    Gaikwadstays captain, the role Dhoni handed him in 2024
    Zaheer Khanis the new head coach. CEO Kasi Viswanathan says Dhoni suggested his name.
    ₹4 crorefreed in CSK's purse for the mini-auction in Goa on 16 December

    “There is no CSK without MS Dhoni.”

    N Srinivasan, CSK owner

    “While we will miss seeing him in yellow on the field, we are glad that he will keep guiding our players.”

    Kasi Viswanathan, CSK managing director
